mapper.sql: id, title, abstract_text, content, authors, keywords, journal, doi, pdf_url, publish_year, category, view_count, download_count, sort, status, publish_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO art_paper (title, abstract_text, content, authors, keywords, journal, doi, pdf_url, publish_year, category, view_count, download_count, sort, status, publish_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{abstractText}, #{content}, #{authors}, #{keywords}, #{journal}, #{doi}, #{pdfUrl}, #{publishYear}, #{category}, #{viewCount}, #{downloadCount}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{publishTime}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updateTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM art_paper WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM art_paper
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR abstract_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY sort ASC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE art_paper SET status = #{status} WHERE id IN #{id}
